numerics.domain_check: initial and every accepted native state; no claim between accepted states

constraints.terminal_energy_reference: Final W_thermal_total of the same nominal fine native run that defines the target
constraints.fusion_energy_requirement: Trapezoidal integral of P_fusion over all accepted native steps of the nominal fine reference run; no allowed production shortfall

objective: worst-case supplied heat: native trapezoidal E_external_total difference (auxiliary plus ohmic) plus accepted-step theta=1 right-endpoint integral of positive native pedestal heat; negative pedestal heat is not credited
scope: Evolving electron/ion heat with prescribed time-independent electron-density and current backgrounds; native quasineutrality/composition determines main-ion and impurity densities; no particle/current control claim

target_definition.required_fusion_energy_quadrature: trapezoidal over all accepted native steps, including t=0 and horizon

energy_accounting.external: native E_external_total, independently checked against accepted-step trapezoidal power integral
energy_accounting.pedestal_positive: sum_k max(P_pedestal(t_k),0)*(t_k-t_{k-1}), k>=1, native theta=1 source coefficients
energy_accounting.initial_state: t0 source is diagnostic only, not an executed implicit step; trapezoidal positive source integral also reported
energy_accounting.external_right_endpoint: reported alongside native trapezoidal value and their signed difference; no claim of exact full-system energy conservation
